extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: single-screen cinema, approx. 17.8 x 24.7 m incl. forecourt, marquee and ticket booth, 13.4 m tall at the stepped facade
extras.notes: exterior only (closed building, opaque windows, no interior); front faces -Y; lit marquee with popcorn, film strip and ticket pictograms instead of film titles, star blade sign, emissive bulbs and light frames, no lettering, no brand; no movable parts

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
